designer: KBR, modifying an original concept by Hermann Tilke

moments.headline: First Formula 1 night race
moments.body: Marina Bay hosted the sport's first night race under floodlights, won by Fernando Alonso for Renault.

moments.headline: Crashgate: Piquet's crash hands Alonso victory
moments.body: Renault later admitted Nelson Piquet Jr crashed deliberately to help Alonso, who won from 15th on the grid.

moments.headline: Singapore Sling chicane replaced at Turn 10
moments.body: The left-right-left chicane at Turn 10 was replaced by a single left-hander.

moments.headline: Float section dropped, circuit shrinks to 19 corners
moments.body: The Turn 16 to 19 section became one long straight, cutting the lap from 23 to 19 corners while the Float was redeveloped.

moments.headline: First Singapore Grand Prix without a safety car
moments.body: Lando Norris won from pole in a race with no safety car, a first in the event's history.

corners.name: Sheares
corners.origin: After the Benjamin Sheares Bridge overhead, named for Singapore's second president.

corners.name: Memorial
corners.origin: Close to the monument honouring civilian victims of the Second World War.

corners.name: Singapore Sling
corners.origin: After Singapore's best-known cocktail, said to originate at Raffles Hotel's Long Bar.
